name: Octagonal Pillow with Decoration of Butterflies and Chrysanthemum Sprays
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；late 12th-early 13th century；Cizhou ware: light gray stoneware with clear glaze over decoration painted in iron-brown slip on a white slip ground. Possibly from the Guantai kilns, near Handan, Hebei province.
